# Pan Global Infotech

> IT hardware sales, service & AMC, plus custom software including GST-compliant Billing Software and CRM Software, based in Mulund West, Mumbai, India.

Pan Global Infotech is an IT hardware and software company based in Mulund West, Mumbai, serving Mulund, Thane, Bhandup, Ghatkopar and Mumbai. We sell and service genuine IT hardware (laptops, desktops, servers, networking, printers, CCTV) from major brands (HP, Dell, Lenovo, Apple, Cisco, Microsoft), offer Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) and chip-level repair, and build custom software including ready-to-deploy GST Billing Software, CRM Software, and tailored ERP/web portal solutions with a free demo available.

## Sections

- [Hardware Division](https://panglobalinfotech.in/#hardware): Commercial laptops & desktops, enterprise servers, networking, AMC, chip-level repair.
- [Software Division](https://panglobalinfotech.in/#software): Licensed software sales, custom ERP/CRM, GST billing software with free demo.
- [Billing & CRM Software](https://panglobalinfotech.in/#billing-software): Ready-to-deploy GST billing software and custom CRM software with a free demo.
- [FAQ](https://panglobalinfotech.in/#faq): Common questions about hardware, AMC, and service areas.
- [Contact](https://panglobalinfotech.in/#contact): Phone, email, office address, and inquiry form.
